authority: Project-shared records only. Writable project agents can create; service owner and viewers only read. Task owner/reviewer are distinct writable project agents, not service owner principals. Task definitions are immutable; reuse creates another run.

request.title: 1..200 bytes
request.scope: 1..32 unique relative file/directory paths, max 300 bytes each; no absolute/parent/backslash paths

request.client_id: identifier; unique per task and actor
request.run_id: identifier; caller-selected new ID for run_started, exact current ID otherwise
request.review_request_id: required only review_result/completion_reported; event ID of current review_requested
request.evidence: required only verification_reported: {status:passed|failed|inconclusive,command:nonempty<=2000,exit_code:integer|null,artifact:ArtifactRef}; artifact must be role=evidence and a member of current full set

response.task: Task (current; may have advanced on replay)

Task.title: string
Task.version: positive integer; initial 1; every event increments

transitions.run_started: Task owner only. Initial ready or previous completion_reported/cancelled; fresh globally unique run_id. No CLI execution.
transitions.artifacts_ready: Task owner only; running/artifacts_ready/changes_requested/approved/review_pending. Nonempty validated full set, all refs must have identical base_revision including evidence; clears review/evidence. Implementation refs must have task owner as uploader; other roles may originate from other current project agents. Historical uploader key revocation/write downgrade does not invalidate an existing artifact; removing uploader project membership does. Publishing actor always needs current live key and write ACL.
transitions.review_requested: Task owner only; artifacts_ready. Artifacts exact canonical full current set; created event.id is review request ID. State review_pending.
transitions.review_result: Task reviewer only; review_pending. Exact run, current request ID and canonical full artifact set required. State approved or changes_requested.
transitions.verification_reported: Task owner or reviewer; artifacts_ready/review_pending/approved/changes_requested. Exact current artifact set and evidence artifact required. Records externally supplied evidence; state unchanged. Last report wins, does not run commands or prove findings.
transitions.completion_reported: Task owner only; approved with passed external verification. Exact current request and full artifact set. Terminal claim, not server-proven completion.
transitions.uncertain: Task owner or reviewer; any nonterminal active run. Invalidates review and verification; retains artifacts as historical context. No automatic replay.
transitions.recovery_decided: Task owner only; uncertain. Explicit resume returns running and clears artifacts/review/evidence; cancel terminal. Records operator/agent decision, does not start or stop any process.
transitions.cancelled: Task owner only; any nonterminal active run. Records cancellation; does not stop an external process.

idempotency: Identical client_id+actor+task payload replay returns 200 original event even if expected_version is old; changed payload returns409. New mutation must match current version or409. No replay side effects. Creation similarly per project+creator+client_id. Unknown/duplicate fields rejected, including nested objects.

errors.403: read-only principal or wrong task role
errors.409: stale CAS/state/request/artifact set/idempotency conflict; inaccessible or incompatible artifact references

response.versions: MemoryVersion[] latest1000 descending version; optional ?before_version=N cursor to older history

memory_semantics: Shared project notes, not private memory. Any writable project agent may append revision via CAS. No deletes or silent overwrite. Immutable legacy /notes unchanged. New client IDs are scoped project+actor across create/update; exact replay returns original accepted revision even after later edits. Task and memory detail reads use one read-only repeatable-read snapshot for metadata/history/capabilities.
limitations: No scheduler, execution, automatic writer replay, process stopping, filesystem fencing or semantic truth checking.
A passed verification report and an approved review remain attributed external statements, not server-executed proof.
Upload evidence before freezing the reviewed full artifact set; a new evidence artifact afterward changes the set and requires a new review.
Project readers see all tasks/memory; never copy restricted-channel or private content into this scope automatically.
Archived project owner history remains readable; ordinary reads and all agent writes denied.
